name: Zendesk Ticket Assistant
summary: Classifies incoming Zendesk tickets by urgency and team, drafts replies for simple ones, and escalates VIP tickets.

items.title: Incoming tickets
items.description: Reads incoming tickets from Zendesk to process them.
items.proved_when: Tickets are successfully fetched from Zendesk.

items.title: Urgency and team classifier
items.description: Classifies incoming tickets by urgency and team.
items.proved_when: Each ticket receives an urgency score and team assignment tag.

items.title: Simple reply drafter
items.description: Drafts a reply for simple tickets.
items.proved_when: A draft reply is generated and attached to simple tickets.
items.source_quote: draft a reply for simple ones

items.title: VIP escalation handler
items.description: Escalates tickets from VIP customers to management or senior support.
items.proved_when: VIP tickets are flagged and moved to an escalation queue.

items.title: Ticket dashboard
items.description: Displays classified tickets, drafts, and escalations in a clear list.
items.proved_when: The user can view tickets categorized by urgency, team, and VIP status.

questions.text: Where should VIP tickets be escalated to?

not_in_this_version.title: Automatic sending of drafted replies
not_in_this_version.reason: The request specifies to draft a reply, not to send them automatically without human review.
